# Fate UI v0.9.8-beta3

This beta updates the embedded Pi SDK to 0.85.1, adds native GPT-6 Astra support, and removes the temporary server dependency needed by the previous SDK release.

## Changes

- GPT-6 Astra now comes from Pi's built-in model catalog for OpenAI API keys and Codex subscriptions. A manual model entry is no longer required.
- Child-agent catalogs and model validation use Pi's supported reasoning levels. Models that cannot turn reasoning off no longer advertise that option.
- Includes Pi's long prompt-cache request fix for GPT-5.6 and newer Responses models.
- Model-discovery requests report the installed SDK version instead of a hard-coded version.
- Keeps the OpenRouter compatibility patch for models without an explicit reasoning-off mapping.
- Fixes the voice-button browser test to wait for a real press before checking its appearance. Its visual assertions are unchanged.

## Compatibility

Existing projects, sessions, credentials, and model configuration are preserved. Manual Astra entries still override Pi's catalog; remove the redundant entry if you want the native defaults. Pi defaults Astra to a 272,000-token context window and does not offer reasoning off. Intentional context and provider overrides remain supported.

## Downloads and verification

The release pipeline checks, builds, and smoke-tests native installers on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64 before publishing.

Public beta installers are unsigned. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS` and back up important work before upgrading.
